title: Damaged garbage
text: Damaged garbage. As I opened these up and I saw they  were shoved in a box folded over. Not sure why this would be appropriate, as it caused a curve in the mats. When I got them out I realized that every single one of these mats was damaged. Each one has a half moon shaped mark/ dent in it. It’s impossible to get out, as the plastic it’s self is actually bent. These are garbage.
